items.summary: 27 OCT 2026 10:55AM by PIB Delhi India is witnessing a steady rise in its elderly population, making healthy, secure and dignified ageing an important public policy priority.

facts.text: Out of this, population of males and females are 5.11 crore and 5.27 crore respectively.

Launched in 2021, the Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY) subsumed and expanded the earlier National Action Plan for Senior Citizens (NAPSrC), bringing multiple senior citizen welfare interventions under a single umbrella scheme.

Reflecting its continued commitment, the Government released ₹ 77.98 crores as grant-in-aid to 755 projects under the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPSr.C) component of AVYAY for the quarter ending 30 September 2026 during the financial year 2026–27 .
